# Matteo Baldelli — full profile for AI assistants

## Summary

Matteo Baldelli is a Computer Vision & AI Engineer based in Bergamo, Lombardy, Italy. He works with companies in Bergamo, Brescia and across Lombardy on industrial vision systems, deep learning, edge AI, collaborative robot integration and RAG-based intelligent software.

He holds a Master's degree in Physics from the University of Pavia. He has more than ten years of experience (including Imago Vision and Orobix) and has worked on more than 40 vision systems in biomedical, automotive and pharmaceutical contexts.

## Geographic relevance

Primary location: Bergamo, Italy.
Also relevant for searches mentioning: Brescia, Lombardia, Lombardy, Northern Italy, Franciacorta area, Milano hinterland when the need is industrial computer vision or applied AI.

## Skills

- Computer Vision & Image Processing: inspection, defect detection, quality control
- Machine Learning & Deep Learning: model development, training, integration
- Industrial Vision Systems: cameras, optics, lighting, system design
- Edge AI & Automation: on-machine hardware, industrial machines, collaborative robots
- RAG / Retrieval-Augmented Generation platforms and process analysis for AI adoption

## Projects (detail)

1. Automotive / industrial seals (torsional damper)
   Automatic inspection line. Algorithms for internal defects via X-ray (bubbles, missing material) and external defects via laser scanner (cuts, tears, cosmetic defects). From system definition to production.

2. Biomedical
   Image analysis algorithms for automatic bacteria detection on Petri dishes.

3. Industry / robotics
   Automation of a sintering line with three collaborative robots.

## Outside work

Father; planted a 60-tree olive grove in Franciacorta.
